identity_policy: INCART official patient IDs grouped across all I files; MIT201/202 alias (only202 included). SVDB patient identities unproven: single conservative group, train-only, never counted as78 subjects. Independent new validation/test exclusively INCART patients; provenance differs from MIT/SVDB, cross-database identity cannot be proved from deidentified records.
old_data_policy: All42 old MIT records demoted to known development training in this new version, including old validation/test already inspected; old protocols/results preserved unchanged. New scores not comparable as same benchmark. v6 validation is now known development validation; original6 test patients retained unused.

window.method: native crop ceil(fs*before/after); segment-local polyphase resample to144Hz with constant boundary; interpolate onto exact common time grid; mean/std per beat. No whole-record fit. Expert annotations; INCART timing not manually corrected. No fitted time offset.

train_sampling.selection: deterministic hash smallest; train-only cap, never validation/test; SVDB record unit is not a verified subject

rr.startup: past means exclude current; empty past uses current

gate.scope: Same assistant engineering thresholds on known development validation and one fresh patient-held-out test; no competition/clinical claim.

training.sampling: Natural TRAIN random permutation, no balanced sampling; TRAIN-only class-weighted CE
training.selection: Best validation macro-F1; tie lower validation cross entropy. Among candidates choose highest validation macro-F1. Do not load test tensors until all candidate selection is finished.
training.augmentation: Per-candidate augment flag controls train-only time/amplitude/noise perturbation
training.determinism: seed Python/NumPy/torch and deterministic CPU algorithms; fixed thread count; versions/hashes saved

test_policy: Do not evaluate test unless validation-selected candidate passes unchanged validation gate. Test patients and bytes identical to v6, never used for training/selection. If failed, keep test unused.
scope: expert-centered mixed-source training with INCART held-out patients; training also contains INCART, not whole-source external validation
data_license: INCART and SVDB ODC Attribution v1.0; raw data remains tmp; retain source attribution

ltdb.identity: No verified patient mapping, whole source train-only unknown identity group; no claim7 distinct patients or6 new F subjects.
ltdb.units: ADC counts; raw header gain0 means uncalibrated. WFDB parser substitutes200; do NOT treat substituted value as known mV.
ltdb.sampling: Choose eligible annotated beats by deterministic hash before waveform extraction; preserve RR history of ALL beat annotations; caps only auxiliary TRAIN
